looks.description: A bearded, rat-like creature and ratkin hooligan standing about a head shorter than a tall man, with furry rat hands and a rat arm, wearing a black vest, blue pants, and a pair of well-worn sandals.
A much larger, hairier, and obsidian bugaboo creature resembling a bear with no neck, featuring enormous, owlish eyes, comically skinny legs, a shaggy face, thick fur, and furry hands.

A man with dusky gray skin, short devil horns jutting from his forehead, and long gray-and-black hair held back in a ponytail. A barbed tail pokes from the rear of his tuxedo, and a pair of black, bat-like wings sits folded tightly against his back.
looks.change: Gray-skinned horned devil man in tuxedo

looks.description: A toad-like creature about five feet tall, mud-colored and slimy, with hanging jowls, a throat pouch beneath its wide face that looks as if it could fill with air, webbed hands, frog-like arms, a long frog tongue and a frog-like face.
A bird resembling an eagle (a skyfowl), with light brown and beige feathers. Like a regular eagle, it has no arms, only feet and wings.

A small, chubby, fuzzy bear-like creature with brown-and-white fur, elf ears, a monkey tail, ridiculously huge eyes like a baby's, and buck teeth. It stands on two legs, knee-height, with fuzzy hands, a fuzzy face and a little furry head, and looks like a bootleg monchichi.
A bipedal ratkin brute with a rat face.

A large, bald, bright pink cyclops with a cone-shaped, furrowed forehead and a pointy head. He has a single brown eye the size of an ostrich egg with a caterpillar-like eyebrow stretched across his head. His wide belly stretches his white shirt to its limits, and his fingers look like fat, wrinkly sausages.
A man wearing a snowsuit and a raccoon hat, with glasses and a pasty hand.
looks.change: Man in snowsuit and raccoon hat

looks.description: A Grim Reaper-style monster with very long arms and desiccated, undead-like skeletal hands, wearing dark canvas-like robes that float lazily in the air and a black hood over his head. When the hood falls back it reveals not a skull but an enormous eyeball that is on fire.
looks.change: Grim Reaper form with burning eyeball
